law.boundary: Fold Lattice != Fold Kernel != XCFE Policy != Execution
law.transition_boundary: Metrics recommend competence movement; XCFE Policy authorizes state/route movement.
law.route_boundary: route_hint is advisory; XCFE remains route authority.
law.full_coordinate: K_t = (F_h, phi, T, s, sigma, X_t)
law.slice_coordinate: K = (theta, sigma) is the phase/competence slice of K_t, not the full runtime identity.
law.fold_boundary: Fold != Xul; fold_state folded/unfolded is independent of the C6 phase pointer.
law.phase_operator_boundary: Fold phases are C6 operations applied over a Fold, not six kinds of Fold and not the Fold learning states.
law.proof_boundary: Sek proposes, Ch'en proves, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits.
law.fold_space_boundary: Fold Lattice is the K = (theta, sigma) phase/competence slice of Fold Space F_K, not the full navigable position.

validated_to_autonomous.authority: XCFE Policy must still authorize final state and route.

invariants.L3: each cell has a unique (theta, sigma) coordinate
invariants.L4: full execution lattice has exactly one active cell per theta
invariants.L7: theta = Xul and sigma = autonomous implies policy_gate = true
invariants.L8: metrics are bounded: rates in [0,1], observations >= 0, teacher_distance >= 0
invariants.L9: evolutionary transition recommendation never bypasses XCFE Policy
invariants.L10: route_hint is advisory; XCFE remains route authority
invariants.L11: fold_state is independent of phase; Fold != Xul
invariants.L12: Sek proposes, Ch'en proves, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits
invariants.L13: K = (theta, sigma) is a slice of K_t = (F_h, phi, T, s, sigma, X_t)
invariants.L14: Fold Lattice K = (theta, sigma) is a projection of Fold Space p_t = (h, phi, T, s, sigma, X_t)
invariants.L15: FoldField score() = W*C*R is a WCR score for a product-graph vertex (node_id, theta); it is distinct from a lattice cell score
invariants.L16: ConvergenceTest tracks Kleene iteration: CONVERGED when d<epsilon, MAX_ITER at n>=max_iter, DIVERGING when k>=k_max for div_window consecutive steps; best_state() holds the FoldState at minimum d
